skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply the principles of business process reengineering, including the identification of business processes, redesigning processes, and restructuring organizations.
Develop critical thinking skills to analyze and solve complex business problems.
Demonstrate leadership skills in group settings and in managing change within organizations.
Work effectively in teams to achieve common goals.
Communicate effectively, both verbally and in writing, to convey complex ideas and solutions.
Apply problem-solving techniques to real-world business scenarios.
Manage projects and tasks efficiently, including planning, execution, and evaluation.
Understand and manage organizational change effectively.
Analyze business operations and identify areas for improvement.
Think strategically about business operations and organizational structure.
Design and implement organizational structures that support business goals.
Promote a culture of continuous improvement within organizations.
Make ethical decisions in business contexts.
Adapt to different work environments and changing business conditions.
Engage in self-directed learning to continuously improve professional skills.
